title: tadu task, format version 2
description: One task per file: todo/open/<id>.json, todo/closed/<id>.json, or (when archiving is enabled) todo/archive/YYYY/<id>.json or todo/archive/YYYY/MM/<id>.json. Vocabulary checks (categories, types) and cross-file checks (unique ids, blocked_by targets, cycles) are done by the checker against todo/tadu.json.

tadu.description: Format version of this file. Readers upgrade older versions; a tool must not rewrite a file with a higher version than it knows.

id.description: t- plus a lowercase UUID4 (122 random bits, no practical collision even across branches). Never changes; equals the file name. Tools display the shortest unique prefix of at least 8 hex digits, and refuse an ambiguous prefix instead of guessing.

title.description: One line, imperative, no trailing period needed.

state.description: tadu v1 markers: [ ] pending, [~] in_progress, [!] blocked, [x] done, [-] cancelled.

category.description: Required. Area of the product; a key of categories in todo/tadu.json, or general (always allowed: tadu's existing fallback category, used by migration when unknown; doctor lists open general tasks for triage).

type.description: Required. Kind of work; one of types in todo/tadu.json (default list: bug feature chore test docs refactor perf security), or untriaged (always allowed: not decided yet; doctor lists open untriaged tasks).

priority.description: Required. untriaged = nobody has decided yet (migration and quick captures use it); doctor lists open untriaged tasks. Sort order: urgent, high, untriaged, normal, low, so unknown work surfaces for triage instead of sinking.

labels.description: Free topic slugs (dark-mode, csv-import). Category and type have their own fields.

milestone.description: Release or milestone this task belongs to; a key of milestones in todo/tadu.json (doctor warns otherwise).

created_by.description: Who recorded the task: a person id of the workspace, or agent:<name> for an AI agent (agent:claude). Set by tadu add.

started.description: Day work began. Set by the tool the first time the task moves to in_progress (tadu claim, tadu set state=in_progress); never moved back. doctor flags in-progress work older than stale_after_days.

defer_until.description: Not before this day: tadu ready hides the task until then. 'Not now' without cancelling it.

queue.description: Only meaningful while pending: ready = can be started now.

assignees.description: Who works on it: person ids of the workspace, or agent:<name> for an AI agent. Never emails or names. tadu claim sets it.

parent.description: Id of the epic or parent task.

blocked_by.description: Tasks that must be closed before this one can proceed. The reverse ('blocks') is computed, never stored. When the last of them closes, tadu close reports this task; the agent decides whether it moves to pending.

related.description: Tasks about the same thing, without an order between them. Stored on one side; tadu show lists both directions.

discovered_from.description: The task whose work revealed this one (an agent found it while doing that task). tadu show lists, for a task, what was discovered from it.

blocker.description: The external condition it waits for (a decision, a vendor, credentials). A blocked task needs blocker, blocked_by, or both.

unblock.description: The smallest action that would unblock it.

notes.description: Description and context as Markdown, one element per line: "" is a blank line, and readers join the elements with \n. Any Markdown round-trips, code blocks and lists included, and diffs and merges work line by line.

done_when.description: Acceptance criteria as Markdown lines (usually one criterion per line): what must be true to close it as done.

links.description: URLs or other URIs: pull requests, issues, documents, designs.

closed.description: Day it was closed (done or cancelled). Retention and archiving use this, never file times.

evidence.description: Proof as Markdown lines (usually one proof per line): test command, commit, PR, report (done).

resolution.description: Why it no longer applies, or what replaced it (cancelled).

superseded_by.description: The task that replaced this one (cancelled).

duplicate_of.description: Closed as a duplicate of this task (state cancelled). Set by tadu close --duplicate-of; tadu show lists, for a task, its duplicates.

^x-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Team extensions; tools keep them untouched.

date.description: A real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. The pattern checks the shape; tadu also rejects impossible days such as 2026-02-30.

lines.description: Multi-line text as an array of lines. No element contains a line break; leading and trailing blank lines are trimmed by the canonical writer.

actor.description: A person id of the workspace, or agent:<name> for an AI agent.
